gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed Histologically proven glioblastoma (WHO criteria 2021), absence of IDH mutation demonstrated by negative IDH1 R132H staining on Immunohistochemistry.

candidate_evidence.quote: This study is evaluating an experimental treatment for glioblastoma that uses an investigational drug (5-ALA) combined with a non-invasive ultrasound device (LIDU) to target tumor cells.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma After Completion of Chemoradiotherapy

role_evidence.quote: 5-ALA HCl (5-amino-levulenic acid) for oral solution (20 mg/kg) p.o. 6-8 hours prior to LIDU SDT
standard of care temozolomide + sonosenitizer + sonodynamic therapy

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: sonosensitizer activated by low intensity diffuse ultrasound sonodynamic therapy

role_evidence.quote: Both groups will continue to receive the standard therapy of oral Temozolomide.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care
